capabilities: Flag AI-tell phrases and cross-sentence patterns in prose
Check text against vault term lists, quote sources, and character name lists
Show sentence-length burstiness in the status bar
Tune check groups with per-note frontmatter and inline directives
Record AI provenance and show the matching Amazon KDP disclosure category
extras: Not yet in the Obsidian community store; install via BRAT or manual download. The manifest notes it has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff, and the README warns checks and defaults may change. Findings can be exported as JSON to a .plumbline/ folder.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to spot machine-written phrasing or enforce a personal style guide, source quotes, and name spellings while writing.

relations.evidence: Plumbline pairs with Annoteca, a commenting plugin for Obsidian.

summary: Prose checker that flags AI-shaped writing and verifies your text against your own style guides, quote sources, and character name lists.
